newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Aug 6.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Aug 6.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Wednesday:
* On Tuesday, the Dow Jones industrial average fell 10.91 points to close at 8,187.54.

* State Planning Minister Ginanjar Kartasasmita said on Tuesday Indonesia would buy 12 Sukhoi Su-30K fighters and eight MI-17-1V helicopters, but added there was a condition for counter purchases, possibly covering palm oil, coffee and rubber.
* On Tuesday, the Jakarta composite index fell 4.83 points, or 0.67 percent, to close at 713.88 points.
* On Wednesday, the rupiah was traded at 2,585.00/95.00 at 0215 GMT against an opening of 2,597.00/2,602.00.
* Transportation firm Steady Safe and toll road operator Citra Marga after Steady Safe's shareholders approved a proposal to acquire up to a 19.9 percent stake in Citra Marga.
* Indosat as the telecommunications firm is scheduled to announce its first half results later on Wednesday.
* Jakarta Kyoei Steel as the firm is scheduled to be listed on Wednesday.
* Bakrieland after an announcement the property firm plans to make a 525 billion rights issue.
* Semen Gresik after a poor first half net profit.
